verdict.rationale: First-party docs say each cloud session exposes a WebSocket endpoint that Playwright, Puppeteer, or any CDP-compatible tool can connect to. The docs also say you can control the cloud Chrome browsers with Puppeteer or Playwright and connect existing automation scripts, so no rewrite is needed. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that existing scripts connect without changes, and detailed connection examples or notes on compatibility limits.
